title: WorkPulse overtime.withdrawn v1
description: A requester withdrew their own open overtime request before verification. Identifiers and the work date only — hours and free text are not needed to record the withdrawal (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the request belongs to (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

work_date.description: The single day the overtime was claimed for (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
